subject: DI03000101

body.en:
Understand the idea

Distributed resistance/inductance are series effects;capacitance/leakage are shunt effects.

Explanation and application

  • Per-length z=r+jωLand y=g+jωC;for uniform length ℓ,Z=zℓ,Y=yℓ.Here L/Cinside per-length expressions are per-length quantities;do not mix Hwith H/km or Fwith µF.
  • Rcauses heating/real-power loss,Lproduces reactive drop,Cdraws charging current and Gmodels insulation leakage.Gis often neglected in elementary overhead models,not assumed zero in every cable.
  • Use measured/manufacturer ACresistance at operating temperature.GMRr′for inductance differs from physical/equivalent capacitive radius r.
Receiving voltage at no load?

At fixed Vs,Vr0=Vs/A.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Distributed R-L series effects અને C-leakage shunt effects છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Per-length z=r+jωL/y=g+jωC છે.Length ℓ માટે Z=zℓ/Y=yℓ લો.Per-length L-Cને total H-F સાથે mix નકરો.
  • R heating-loss,L reactive drop,C charging I/G insulation leakage દર્શાવે.G elementary overheadમાં ignore થાય;દરેક cableમાં zero એવું નથી.
  • Operating-T AC R અને manufacturer data લો.Inductance GMRr′ તથા capacitive physical/equivalent r અલગ છે.
No-load Receiving Voltage?

Fixed Vsમાં Vr0=Vs/A છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Balanced transposed three-phase overhead line,negligible earth influence,round nonmagnetic solid conductor for r′≈0.7788r;use actual GMRfor stranded/bundled conductors.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Average geometry uses Dm=(DabDbcDca)^(1/3);for equilateral spacing Dm=D.
  2. Integrating external magnetic flux linkage proportional to dr/r gives a logarithmic term;including internal linkage through GMRgives Lphase=2×10^−7ln(Dm/r′)H/m.
  3. From electric field E=λ/(2πεr),integrate radial potential:V=λln(Dm/r)/(2πε).Thus Cphase=λ/V=2πε/ln(Dm/r)F/m.
  4. Example D4m,r0.01m,air ε≈8.854×10^−12F/m gives L≈1.248mH/km,C≈0.00929µF/km;at50Hz XL≈0.392Ω/km.

Interpretation and check

These are idealised geometry equations,not cable design formulas;earth,sheath,bundling and actual strand data change the model.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Balanced transposed overhead line/earth effect ignore કરો.Solid nonmagnetic round wireમાં r′≈0.7788r છે.Stranded-bundledમાં actual GMR લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Average geometryમાં Dm=(DabDbcDca)^(1/3) છે.Equilateralમાં Dm=D છે.
  2. External magnetic flux linkageના dr/r integrationથી log term મળે.Internal linkage GMRમાં લેતાં Lphase=2×10^−7ln(Dm/r′)H/m છે.
  3. E=λ/(2πεr)થી radial integration કરતાં V=λln(Dm/r)/(2πε) છે.તેથી Cphase=2πε/ln(Dm/r)F/m છે.
  4. D4m,r0.01m/air ε≈8.854×10^−12F/mમાં L≈1.248mH/km,C≈0.00929µF/km અને50Hzએ XL≈0.392Ω/km છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

આ ideal geometry equations છે,cable design formulas નથી.Earth,sheath,bundle/strand data model બદલે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Use the simplest equivalent circuit that keeps the required accuracy for the actual electrical length.

Explanation and application

  • Short line:series R/Xwith charging neglected.Medium:series impedance plus lumped shunt admittance using end-condenser,nominal Tor nominal π.
  • Long line:parameters are distributed and exact propagation/ABCDrelations are needed;do not present the medium approximation as exact long-line performance.
  • Underground cables can have important capacitance at shorter lengths than overhead conductors;length alone does not settle model choice.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Actual electrical length/accuracy માટે યોગ્ય સૌથી સરળ equivalent model લો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Shortમાં series R-X/charging ignore થાય.Mediumમાં series Z સાથે lumped Y માટે end-condenser,T/π વપરાય.
  • Longમાં distributed parameters/exact propagation-ABCD જોઈએ.Medium approximationને exact long-line result નકહો.
  • Cableમાં ઓછી lengthએ પણ C મહત્વનું હોઈ શકે.ફક્ત length પરથી model નક્કી નકરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Each phase occupies each geometric position for equal total distance to balance average coupling.

Explanation and application

  • Unsymmetrical spacing gives unequal average L/Ccoupling and can cause unbalance or interference;systematic position exchange makes the ideal averaged parameters more nearly equal.
  • Three sections use a cyclic phase-position sequence;electrical phase identity is preserved from source to load.Phases are not electrically joined at crossing points.
  • Transposition does not remove all unbalance,mutual coupling or zero-sequence effects;actual double circuits/earth geometry need their full model.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

દરેક phase દરેક geometric positionમાં equal કુલ distance રહે જેથી average coupling balance થાય.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Unsymmetrical spacingથી unequal L-C/unbalance-interference થઈ શકે.Systematic position exchangeથી average parameters લગભગ સમાન બને.
  • ત્રણ sectionsમાં cyclic position sequence લો.Source-load phase identity જાળવો.Crossings પર phases electrically જોડાતા નથી.
  • Transposition બધું unbalance,mutual/zero-sequence effect દૂર નથી કરતું.Double-circuit/earth માટે full model જોઈએ.

title.en: 2.4 Short and medium line models:end-condenser,Tand π

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Balanced per-phase RMSphasors:receiving Vr,load Ir,series Z=R+jX;neglect shunt charging.

Step-by-step solution

  1. No shunt branch means Is=Ir.The series drop is ZIr,so Vs=Vr+ZIr.
  2. Two-port convention Vs=AVr+BIr,Is=CVr+DIr gives A=D=1,B=Z,C=0.
  3. At fixed Vs,the no-load receiving voltage Vr0=Vs/A=Vs.Regulation=(|Vr0|−|Vr|)/|Vr|×100.
  4. Pout=3Re(VrIr*)=3|Vr||Ir|cosφ;Pin=Pout+3|Ir|²R;η=Pout/Pin×100.

Interpretation and check

Regulation uses magnitudes and fixed sending conditions;do not subtract complex phasors and call that scalar regulation.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Balanced per-phase RMSમાં Vr,Ir/Z=R+jX લો.Shunt charging ignore કરો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Shunt branch ન હોવાથી Is=Ir અને Vs=Vr+ZIr છે.
  2. Two-port conventionથી A=D=1,B=Z/C=0 મળે.
  3. Fixed Vsમાં no-load Vr0=Vs/A=Vs છે.Regulation=(|Vr0|−|Vr|)/|Vr|×100 લો.
  4. Pout=3Re(VrIr*)=3|Vr||Ir|cosφ છે.Pin=Pout+3|Ir|²R અને η=Pout/Pin×100 છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Regulationમાં magnitudes/fixed sending conditions લો.Complex subtractionને scalar regulation નકહો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

All total shunt admittance Yis lumped at the receiving end;series line Zcarries load plus charging current.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Ic=YVr;Is=Ir+YVr.
  2. Vs=Vr+ZIs=(1+ZY)Vr+ZIr.
  3. Therefore A=1+ZY,B=Z,C=Y,D=1;AD−BC=1but A≠Din general because the circuit is asymmetric.

Interpretation and check

This is a coarse lumped model;large receiving-end charging concentration can reduce accuracy compared with Tor π.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Total Y receiving end પર lump કરો.Series Zમાં load+charging I વહે છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Ic=YVr/Is=Ir+YVr છે.
  2. Vs=Vr+ZIs=(1+ZY)Vr+ZIr છે.
  3. તેથી A=1+ZY,B=Z,C=Y/D=1 છે.AD−BC=1 છે,પણ asymmetric circuitથી સામાન્ય રીતે A≠D છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

આ coarse model છે.End પર બધું charging lump કરતાં T-π કરતાં accuracy ઓછી થઈ શકે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Put Z/2on each side of one central shunt Y;define midpoint Vm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. From the receiving side,Vm=Vr+(Z/2)Ir.
  2. Shunt current YVmadds to load current:Is=Ir+YVm=YVr+(1+YZ/2)Ir.
  3. Vs=Vm+(Z/2)Is.Substitute both expressions and collect Vr/Irterms.
  4. A=D=1+YZ/2;B=Z(1+YZ/4);C=Y.Check AD−BC=1.

Interpretation and check

Yis total admittance,not Y/2in the central branch;all Z/Yvalues refer to the same phase and line length.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Middle shunt Yની બંને બાજુ Z/2 લો.Midpoint Vm કહો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Receiving sideથી Vm=Vr+(Z/2)Ir છે.
  2. Shunt current ઉમેરતાં Is=Ir+YVm=YVr+(1+YZ/2)Ir છે.
  3. Vs=Vm+(Z/2)Isમાં expressions substitute કરી Vr-Ir terms ભેગાં કરો.
  4. A=D=1+YZ/2,B=Z(1+YZ/4)/C=Y છે.AD−BC=1 ચકાસો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Middle branchમાં total Y છે,Y/2 નથી.બધા Z-Y same phase/lengthના હોવા જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Place Y/2at each end and total Zin the series path;let I1flow in Z.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Receiving shunt adds I1=Ir+(Y/2)Vr.
  2. Vs=Vr+ZI1=(1+ZY/2)Vr+ZIr.
  3. Sending shunt adds Is=I1+(Y/2)Vs;substitute and collect terms.
  4. A=D=1+YZ/2;B=Z;C=Y(1+YZ/4).Check AD−BC=1.

Interpretation and check

Tand πare different approximations with matching A/Dbut different B/C;do not mix their constants in one calculation.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

બંને ends પર Y/2 અને seriesમાં total Z લો.Z currentને I1 કહો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Receiving shuntથી I1=Ir+(Y/2)Vr છે.
  2. Vs=Vr+ZI1=(1+ZY/2)Vr+ZIr છે.
  3. Sending shuntથી Is=I1+(Y/2)Vs છે.Substitute કરી terms ભેગાં કરો.
  4. A=D=1+YZ/2,B=Z/C=Y(1+YZ/4) છે.AD−BC=1 ચકાસો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

T-πમાં A-D સરખાં પણ B-C જુદાં છે.એક calculationમાં constants mix નકરો.

title.en: 2.5 Load power factor and voltage profile
title.gu: 2.5 Load Power Factor તથા Voltage Profile

h.en: Load power factor and voltage profile
h.gu: Load Power Factor તથા Voltage Profile

body.en:
Understand the idea

The phase of current determines which part of ZIcontributes to the receiving-reference voltage drop.

Explanation and application

  • For lagging load,approximate phase drop ΔV≈I(Rcosφ+Xsinφ).For leading load the reactive term reverses:ΔV≈I(Rcosφ−Xsinφ).
  • At a fixed delivered real power and voltage,poor power factor raises current and I²Rloss;for a fixed current,loss is unchanged by pfitself.The comparison assumption matters.
  • Medium-line charging can offset some lagging reactive current or raise voltage at light load;leading loads can cause negative regulation.Use full phasors when the approximation is inadequate.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Current phase પ્રમાણે ZIનો receiving-reference voltage drop નક્કી થાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Laggingમાં ΔV≈I(Rcosφ+Xsinφ),leadingમાં ΔV≈I(Rcosφ−Xsinφ) છે.
  • Fixed delivered P-Vમાં poor pfથી I/loss વધે.Fixed Iમાં pf બદલાય એટલે જ I²R બદલાતું નથી.Comparison assumption મહત્વનું છે.
  • Medium charging lagging reactive Iનો ભાગ compensate કરે કે light loadમાં V વધારે શકે.Leading loadમાં negative regulation થઈ શકે.જરૂરે full phasors લો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Per phase Vr230V,Ir10Aat0.8lagging,Z=0.1+j0.2Ω;balanced three-phase computed case,not lab readings.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Ir=10(0.8−j0.6)=8−j6A;ZIr=2+j1V.
  2. Vs=232+j1V,|Vs|≈232.0022V;regulation≈0.8705%.
  3. Pout=3×230×10×0.8=5520W;loss=3×10²×0.1=30W.
  4. η=5520/(5520+30)×100≈99.4595%.

Interpretation and check

The reference230Vis phase voltage;line-line quantities require √3conversion consistently.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Per phase Vr230V,Ir10A/0.8lagging,Z=0.1+j0.2Ω લો.Balanced computed case છે,lab readings નથી.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Ir=10(0.8−j0.6)=8−j6A/ZIr=2+j1V છે.
  2. Vs=232+j1V,|Vs|≈232.0022V/regulation≈0.8705% છે.
  3. Pout=3×230×10×0.8=5520W/loss=3×10²×0.1=30W છે.
  4. η=5520/(5520+30)×100≈99.4595% છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

230V phase reference છે.Line-line માટે √3 conversion consistent રાખો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Per phase Z=10+j20Ω,Y=j0.001S,Vr10000V,Ir=80−j60A;nominal T model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. A=D=0.99+0.005j,B=9.9+19.925jΩ,C=0+0.001jS.
  2. Vs=AVr+BIr=11887.5+1050jV;Is=CVr+DIr=79.5-49jA.
  3. Pout=2400000W;Pin=3Re(VsIs*)=2680818.7500W;η=89.5249%.
  4. At fixed Vs,Vr0=Vs/A;regulation=20.5417%.

Interpretation and check

Use charging current in sending power;3Ir²Ris not the complete medium-model loss expression when currents differ between series sections.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Per phase Z=10+j20Ω,Y=j0.001S,Vr10000V/Ir=80−j60A લો.Nominal T model છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. A=D=0.99+0.005j,B=9.9+19.925jΩ,C=0+0.001jS છે.
  2. Vs=11887.5+1050jV/Is=79.5-49jA છે.
  3. Pout=2400000W,Pin=3Re(VsIs*)=2680818.7500W/η=89.5249% છે.
  4. Fixed Vsમાં Vr0=Vs/A/regulation=20.5417% છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Sending powerમાં charging I લો.Series sectionsમાં I અલગ હોય ત્યારે ફક્ત3Ir²R complete medium loss નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Per phase Z=10+j20Ω,Y=j0.001S,Vr10000V,Ir=80−j60A;nominal π model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. A=D=0.99+0.005j,B=10+20jΩ,C=-2.5e-06+0.000995jS.
  2. Vs=AVr+BIr=11900+1050jV;Is=CVr+DIr=79.475-49.05jA.
  3. Pout=2400000W;Pin=3Re(VsIs*)=2682750.0000W;η=89.4604%.
  4. At fixed Vs,Vr0=Vs/A;regulation=20.6675%.

Interpretation and check

Use charging current in sending power;3Ir²Ris not the complete medium-model loss expression when currents differ between series sections.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Per phase Z=10+j20Ω,Y=j0.001S,Vr10000V/Ir=80−j60A લો.Nominal π model છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. A=D=0.99+0.005j,B=10+20jΩ,C=-2.5e-06+0.000995jS છે.
  2. Vs=11900+1050jV/Is=79.475-49.05jA છે.
  3. Pout=2400000W,Pin=3Re(VsIs*)=2682750.0000W/η=89.4604% છે.
  4. Fixed Vsમાં Vr0=Vs/A/regulation=20.6675% છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Sending powerમાં charging I લો.Series sectionsમાં I અલગ હોય ત્યારે ફક્ત3Ir²R complete medium loss નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative aluminium model:ρ20=0.028Ω·mm²/m,A100mm²,α0.004/°C,T70°C;L1mH/km,f50Hz,length50km.Ignore skin/proximity correction for this DCresistance illustration.

Step-by-step solution

  1. R20per km=ρℓ/A=0.028×1000/100=0.28Ω/km.
  2. R70=R20[1+α(70−20)]=0.336Ω/km.
  3. XL=2πfL=2π×50×0.001≈0.31416Ω/km.
  4. Total Z=50(0.336+j0.31416)≈16.8+j15.708Ωper phase.

Interpretation and check

Actual ACresistance requires the conductor construction,operating temperature and frequency;the declared αis illustrative.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Illustrative ρ20=0.028Ω·mm²/m,A100mm²,α0.004/°C/T70°C લો.L1mH/km,f50Hz/length50km છે.DCRexampleમાં skin-proximity ignore કરો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. R20=0.028×1000/100=0.28Ω/km છે.
  2. R70=R20[1+α(70−20)]=0.336Ω/km છે.
  3. XL=2πfL=2π×50×0.001≈0.31416Ω/km છે.
  4. Total per-phase Z=50(0.336+j0.31416)≈16.8+j15.708Ω છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Actual AC R માટે conductor construction,T/f જોઈએ.Declared α illustrative છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

At light/no load a sufficiently capacitive ACline can have receiving voltage greater than sending voltage.

Explanation and application

  • Charging current flows even when Ir=0;its interaction with series inductance can produce a voltage rise.For a nominal model,Vr0=Vs/Aand |A|may be below one.
  • It is more important with long lines/high capacitance and cables;load,pf,loss and compensation modify it.It does not mean a line creates energy.
  • Use approved shunt reactors,voltage control,switching and operating limits;the correct remedy follows a system study.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Light-no loadમાં capacitive AClineનું receiving V sending કરતાં વધી શકે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Ir=0 છતાં charging I વહે છે.Series L સાથે V rise થઈ શકે.Nominal modelમાં Vr0=Vs/A અને |A| એકથી ઓછું હોઈ શકે.
  • Long/high-C/cableમાં અસર વધુ છે.Load,pf,loss/compensation અસર બદલે.Line ઊર્જા બનાવે છે એવું નથી.
  • Approved shunt reactor,V control/switching-limits લો.Remedy system studyથી નક્કી થાય.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A synchronous grid coordinates ACfrequency and power balance over interconnected regions.

Explanation and application

  • India has Northern,Western,Eastern,North-Eastern and Southern operational regions in one synchronous national system;separate regional coordination does not mean separate normal frequencies.
  • SLDCcoordinates state operation;five RLDCs coordinate regions;NLDCcoordinates the national system.GRID-INDIAoperates the national/regional centres.Network ownership and regulatory authority are different roles.
  • Transmission constraints,reserves,protection and stability still limit transfers;one grid does not guarantee unlimited interchange or identical retail tariffs.

Reference: [3](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1992887) — PIB GRID-INDIA release.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Synchronous grid interlinked regionsમાં ACfrequency/power balance coordinate કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Indiaમાં Northern,Western,Eastern,North-Eastern/Southern operational regions છે;regional coordination અલગ એટલે normal frequency અલગ નથી.
  • SLDC state,પાંચ RLDC regions/NLDC national operation coordinate કરે.GRID-INDIA national-regional centres ચલાવે.Network ownership/regulation અલગ roles છે.

title.en: 2.9 One Sun One World One Grid
title.gu: 2.9 One Sun One World One Grid

h.en: One Sun One World One Grid
h.gu: One Sun One World One Grid

body.en:
Understand the idea

OSOWOGis a vision for wider renewable-energy interconnection,not a claim that a single worldwide grid is already complete.

Explanation and application

  • Daylight and renewable-resource diversity across regions can complement supply through interconnections,time-zone diversity and storage/flexible resources.
  • Benefits depend on transmission capacity,losses,availability and economic exchange;nighttime imports still require generation or stored energy elsewhere.
  • Cross-border security,commercial agreements,dispatch rules,regulation and protection compatibility are essential;distinguish vision,proposals and commissioned links in reports.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

OSOWOG wider renewable interconnectionની vision છે;worldwide grid પૂર્ણ થઈ ગઈ છે એવો દાવો નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Daylight/resource/time-zone diversity interconnection તથા storage-flexible resourcesથી supply complement કરી શકે.
  • Benefits capacity,loss,availability/economics પર આધારિત છે.Night imports માટે બીજી જગ્યાએ generation/storage જરૂરી છે.
  • Security,commercial agreement,dispatch/regulation/protection compatibility જરૂરી છે.Reportમાં vision,proposal/commissioned link અલગ રાખો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Dispatch centres maintain secure coordinated operation,not merely display energy statistics.

Explanation and application

  • Monitor SCADA/telemetry,state estimates,frequency,voltage and loading;validate data and detect constraint violations.
  • Coordinate schedules,real-time balancing,reserve use,congestion management and renewable variation under the applicable grid code.
  • Coordinate outages,emergency instructions,islanding/restoration plans and post-event analysis with authorised utilities;operators do not bypass protection for economic dispatch.
  • GRID-INDIAnational/regional coordination and SLDCstate coordination differ from the CERC/SERCregulatory role and the asset-owner maintenance role.

Reference: [3](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1992887) — PIB GRID-INDIA release.
